change_records.expected_visual_delta: The exact branded current-profile screenshots shown beside the frozen S9 baseline PNGs in the approved Light, Dark, Increased Contrast, AX Text, Differentiate Without Color, Reduce Motion and Reduce Transparency packets; profile settings and per-state candidate hashes remain unchanged. This record grants no minimum-profile visual result.
